mapper.select: SELECT c.contact_id, c.tenant_id, c.contact_type, c.full_name, c.phone_number, c.email, c.wechat_openid, c.wechat_unionid, c.gender, c.date_of_birth, c.id_type, c.id_number_encrypted, c.nationality_country_code, c.address_province, c.address_city, c.address_district, c.address_detail, c.postal_code, c.contact_status, c.member_level, c.total_stays, c.total_amount, c.last_stay_date, c.remarks, c.create_dept, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time FROM pms_customer_contacts c WHERE c.contact_id = #{contactId} AND c.del_flag = '0'

SELECT t.tag_id, t.name, t.color, t.category, t.description, t.is_system, t.sort_order FROM pms_contact_tags t INNER JOIN pms_contact_tag_relations r ON t.tag_id = r.tag_id WHERE r.contact_id = #{contactId} AND t.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC, t.tag_id ASC
